rules.title: Validate window_days parameter
rules.statement: Raise exception LMS-031 if p_window_days is NULL or outside 1..90; no default or other handling.
rules.notes: Declared as int with no precision; exact bounds check only.

rules.title: Initialize counters
rules.statement: Set p_posted and p_skipped to 0 before processing.

rules.title: Skip NPA loans
rules.statement: For any loan with asset_class = 'NPA', increment p_skipped and skip all further processing for that loan.

rules.title: Require benchmark_code
rules.statement: Raise exception LMS-005 if benchmark_code IS NULL on a floating-rate loan.

rules.title: Compute next reset date
rules.statement: Calculate v_months as full months since disb_date, round down to multiple of reset_months then add one reset_months interval; set v_next to disb_date plus that many months.
rules.notes: Uses extract(year/month from age) with integer division; no day-count fraction or holiday adjustment.

rules.title: Window filter on reset date
rules.statement: Skip loan if v_next > p_as_of + p_window_days.
rules.notes: Inclusive of p_as_of; no time component.

rules.title: Adjust notice date for weekend
rules.statement: Set v_notice to v_next plus 2 days if Saturday (dow=6), plus 1 day if Sunday (dow=0), else v_next unchanged.
rules.notes: Only Saturday/Sunday adjustment; no other holidays.

rules.title: Compute new rate
rules.statement: v_new = (most recent benchmark_rate.rate_pct where benchmark_code matches and effective_date <= v_next, or 0 if none) + coalesce(spread_pct, 0).
rules.notes: Uses LIMIT 1 DESC on effective_date; missing benchmark yields 0; spread missing yields 0.

rules.title: Compute old rate
rules.statement: v_old = (most recent benchmark_rate.rate_pct where benchmark_code matches and effective_date <= (disb_date + (v_months - reset_months) months), or 0 if none) + coalesce(spread_pct, 0).
rules.notes: Same rounding/missing-value handling as new rate; prior cycle start date computed inline.

rules.title: Skip small rate change or duplicate notice
rules.statement: If abs(v_new - v_old) < 0.25 or a RESET_NOTICE entry already exists with note starting 'reset ' || v_next, increment p_skipped and skip insert.
rules.notes: Threshold 0.25 is hardcoded; duplicate check uses LIKE on note text.

rules.title: Insert reset notice
rules.statement: Insert into loan_ledger: loan_id, entry_date = v_notice, entry_type = 'RESET_NOTICE', amount = v_new, note = 'reset ' || v_next || ' from ' || v_old || ' to ' || v_new; increment p_posted.
rules.notes: Amount column receives the new rate value; no rounding function applied to v_new.

open_questions: Is using 0 for missing benchmark_rate or NULL spread_pct the intended fallback?
Is the 0.25 rate-change threshold and its absolute-value comparison confirmed?
Should the weekend adjustment also respect local holidays or only Sat/Sun?
Is the duplicate-notice check via note LIKE pattern considered reliable for business purposes?
